proof: Subtract the SHA-256 equations A_t=T1+T2 and E_t=d+T1. For fixed T2-d, E_t=A_t-(T2-d) is unique. Any extra masks leave zero or one permitted E_t, not an independent variable.
scope: The universal identity follows algebraically. Finite controls do not prove an attack success probability, global freedom count, impossibility with earlier rows reopened, or implementation cost.
